race: Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Welcome to The Race Weekend Podcast, and Las Vegas is about to turn the lights on for a real title fight. We are here for the street, the speed, and the stakes.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: Three United States grands prix, cowboy boots, cocktails and casinos, and this is the one with the casino energy. It is loud, it is fast, and it is very American.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: We are late in the season, but the championship is still alive, and every point is suddenly worth a fortune. That is why this weekend feels different.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: Mercedes are chasing the crown, Ferrari want a statement, and Red Bull want the street crown again. All three teams can change the whole picture.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Before the first free practice lap, this is our thinking going into the predictions, not just a table read. We want the story, the form, and the night.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: Quick news first: the BBC are showing how to follow Las Vegas, and the United States calendar keeps getting louder. You can watch it, feel it, and join the party.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: There is also a nice piece on one race wonders, which makes this street circuit feel like a special night. One lap can change a driver's whole weekend.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: And Lewis is doing the right thing on F1 diversity, so expect more than just racing this weekend. That is the human side, and it matters off track.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Now the big one: Kimi Antonelli is our top pick, and I think that is easy. He has the crown in sight, the wins, and the momentum.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: Easy? He is championship leader, has multiple wins, and his form is scary. If he gets a clean start, nobody wants to be on his bumper.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: At Las Vegas he has one podium, an average of third, and that fits his current run. The street suits him, and the team is clicking.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: I am not saying no, but Max Verstappen is our second, and that is not a mistake. He knows how to win at night, and he is still dangerous.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: How do you beat that? Max has the best historical Las Vegas record, two podiums over three races, and a win here already. That is a serious edge.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: That is the man. But Lewis Hamilton is third, and I will defend that all weekend. Ferrari are strong, and he has the street experience.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Are you serious? His average finish is fifth point seven, so this is a podium hope, not a sure thing. But Hamilton can make the night happen.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: That is the gamble, and I like it. Lewis has a second here before, and he knows how to manage a big night. If Ferrari are quick, he is there.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: I will give you that, but the data says Lewis is a podium chase, not a lock. So our third is brave, and I think that is honest.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: Deep cut: Pierre Gasly is our tenth, and that is the surprise. Alpine are not in the top three, but Gasly has been solid in the United States.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Consistent points, recent top ten, and a Las Vegas night can flip everything. He is the kind of driver who makes you look up.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: That is the kind of pick that keeps the conversation alive. If Gasly scores, we can all smile and say the data caught it.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Now let us look at the rest, because there is plenty of speed here. Charles Leclerc is fourth, and he is a Las Vegas regular.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: He has been strong here before, and Ferrari are fast. George Russell is fifth, and Mercedes are not the only team in the box.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Lando Norris is sixth, and McLaren have shown the pace. Isack Hadjar is seventh, because Red Bull have shown consistent points form.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: Oscar Piastri is eighth, and he has been in the mix. Liam Lawson is ninth, and Racing Bulls are quietly doing the job.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: Pierre Gasly is tenth, and we already gave him the deep cut. But that is the fun part, because this grid is so tight.

segments.speaker: jake
segments.text: One last thought: if the night goes sideways, any of these ten can rise. That is what Las Vegas does.

segments.speaker: tom
segments.text: So here is the full top ten in one breath: Kimi Antonelli, Max Verstappen, Lewis Hamilton, Charles Leclerc, George Russell, Lando Norris, Isack Hadjar, Oscar Piastri, Liam Lawson, Pierre Gasly. Las Vegas, let the lights go out.
